name: 05-02-p1-32-comment-review
title: P1 Comment Review Baseline
description: Implement prompts/0420 Spec 32 compatible local-first comment review baseline with real persistence, anchor drift, review state, margin notes, track changes service/store, validation, docs, and no mock UI.
creator: ZRainbow1275
notes: Completed compatible local-first Comment Review baseline. Implemented Dexie v14 comments/marginNotes/trackChanges stores, zod-validated comment-review domain types, deterministic anchor drift, mention/inline markdown helpers, track-change text helpers, CommentReviewRepository with real persistence and audit actions, and useCommentReviewStore. Validation passed: task validate, targeted comment-review Vitest 7 tests, vue-tsc --noEmit, ESLint quiet, full Vitest 13 files/85 tests, pnpm build, targeted git diff --check, no BOM/Emoji scan, and clean Playwright browser smoke on real Vite/IndexedDB v14 with zero console errors. GitNexus/Serena/ABCoder MCP attempts returned Transport closed, so blast-radius validation is recorded as unavailable rather than faked. Live Tiptap decorations, comment panel UI, selected-text toolbar/context-menu wiring, Track Changes editor visuals, margin-note tooltip, PDF side-note export, E2E/a11y, and 100-comment performance benchmarks remain pending for a future full Spec 32 pass.
